item.title: [LU-20537] sanity-krb5 test_[10,13,152,200,201] solid failures
item.description:
I have recently pushed 2 different patches ([#66081|https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/66081] , #67591), respectively for 2 different problems (LU-20296, LU-20530), and for which I have specified the following/additional Test-Parameters :

Test-Parameters: kerberos=true testlist=sanity-krb5
Test-Parameters: testgroup=review-dne-selinux-ssk-part-2

And they both encounter sanity-krb5 test_[10,13,152,200,201] same and solid failures being based on recent master code !

Direct links to both recent test runs and failures can be found at :

https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/c9a0c5b1-9e2b-40e4-b22c-5cd63099523c for LU-20296/#66081
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/994ebff3-56af-4c7e-a2a3-c5fbf77db73e for LU-20530/#67591

 

And more precisely, each of the 5 sub-tests errors looks always the same and as following :

Name      Duration        Code    Error                                                                     Bugs      Status

test_10         15                 1         bad refcnt 1 on key                                                              FAIL

test_13         15                 1         expected 4 keys in the keyring, found 5 (1)                         FAIL

test_152        7                  1         remaining 1 keys for user                                                     FAIL

test_200       4                  1         umount /mnt/lustre failed                                                       FAIL

test_201        3                  1         mkdir /mnt/lustre/d201.sanity-krb5 failed                             FAIL

 
 

I will need to find a way to exclude these 5 sub-tests to get positive reviews

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

bfaccini-nvda With debug patch https://review.whamcloud.com/67732 sitting on current tip of master ("LU-16489 tests: lustre-rsync-test/2c sync last unlinks"), I cannot reproduce the problems reported in this ticket, see full test results:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/related?jobs=lustre-reviews&builds=128674#redirect
The only weird thing I see is the error 'all contexts should have expired' hit by sanity-krb5 test_201, only when a subset of all sanity-krb5 tests are launched (0 10 13 152 200 201 in this case):
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/92b6ec7e-d6d0-41a6-ad58-e88a525508fe

I believe this may be because you only try to run ONLY the sub-tests expected to fail, in addition of test_0, and thus avoid cases where these failures are false-positives and only the consequence of previous sub-test[s] issue during full sanity-krb5 suite run ...

Why didn't you simply try to run full sanity-krb5 after you had re-based on current master and see if problem is still there ?

I believe this may be because you only try to run ONLY the sub-tests expected to fail

No I also ran the full sanity-krb5 suite:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/78903da0-4311-48eb-a44b-d247db0597ed
It passed.

Right, sorry I had missed your first Test-Parameters line in the Commit message.

So do we need to admit that you have somewhat "magically" fixed the problem by rebasing on top of more recent master branch with its addition of about 50 patches that look unrelated to me ??

Would have been cool if you could find the reason/explanation of the previous failures...
FYI I pushed patch "LU-20543 gss: fix leftover key on failed negotiation" at https://review.whamcloud.com/68440 to fix the sanity-krb5 failures.

After re-integrating this set of sanity-krb5 test[10,13,152,200,201]_ sub-tests for #66081 , also rebased with latest master, the exact same errors have been reproduced  !!
See at https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/a4eba454-604f-4e13-b606-a7b921e7ea5e .

sebastien would be cool if you could have a look to verify if your patch for LU-20543 is a good candidate to fix these errors as you seem to expect ?!

Well, as you can see from the test result of patch "LU-20543 gss: fix leftover key on failed negotiation" at https://review.whamcloud.com/68440, none of the sanity-krb5 sessions failed on one of the tests you are mentioning (the only failures are related to dbench, which is a different problem not tackled by patch "LU-20543 gss: fix leftover key on failed negotiation"). Two patches are based on this one, and they did not hit any of the sanity-krb5 failures mentioned here either:
"LU-19079 krb: mount-point specific principal" at https://review.whamcloud.com/66526
"66527: LU-19079 krb: use .lgss to specify principal" at https://review.whamcloud.com/66527

bfaccini-nvda you could rebase your patch on top of "LU-20543 gss: fix leftover key on failed negotiation" at https://review.whamcloud.com/68440.
